question:
Fill in the blank with the correct synonym of the word "lavish":

Her ________ donation to the cause greatly benefited the community.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lavish"** means something that is very generous or extravagant; it often refers to something that is given in large amounts. (उदार)

 
 
• **Example: **The king threw a** lavish** banquet for his guests, complete with the finest foods and wines.
 
 
 
• **"Generous" **refers to someone who is willing to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **generous** donation to the cause greatly benefited the community.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'lavish' **is **'generous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stingy **(कंजूस): Unwilling to give or spend; ungenerous.

 
 
• **Example:** He is so **stingy **that he never donates to charity.
 
 
 
• **Contradictory **(विरोधाभासी ): Mutually opposed or inconsistent.
 
 
• **Example: **His statements were **contradictory** and confused everyone.
 
 
 
• **Miserly** (कंजूस): Relating to or characteristic of a miser; hoarding wealth and spending as little as possible.
 
 
• **Example:** The** miserly** old man refused to give even a penny to the beggar.
